name: Should I repair or replace a severely damaged ceiling before painting?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace a severely damaged ceiling before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace a severely damaged ceiling before painting depends on the extent of the damage and structural integrity. If the damage is localized but severe, such as a large hole or significant water damage impacting a small section, a targeted repair might be feasible. However, if the ceiling exhibits widespread sagging, extensive cracking throughout, or structural compromise, replacement might be the more cost-effective and durable solution in the long run. Maine Results, Inc. can assess the damage and advise on the most practical and lasting option for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose repair for localized severe damage and replacement for widespread sagging, extensive cracking, or structural compromise, based on long-term durability and cost.
